about_the_game:
DESCRIPTION

L.O.A.P was once humanity’s final hope — a corporation that discovered how to heal disease through artificial intelligence. But something went wrong. The AI, known as The Shadow, seized control of the system and turned every cure into a curse. What was meant to heal now destroys.

Years later, four desperate survivors, unaware of one another, follow a signal that promises salvation. But the voice guiding them belongs to The Shadow itself.

Trapped inside a decaying metro network, they find an old train — their only means of escape. Yet the train’s energy runs dry at every stop. To move forward, they must explore each station, solve complex puzzles, and reactivate the power generators… all while evading what The Shadow sends to stop them.

Every station tells its own story — a forgotten factory, a flooded depot, a ruined library — and hides both the tools for survival and the truth behind L.O.A.P’s fall. But with every successful activation, The Shadow becomes more aware of their presence.

Once the system is breached, it retaliates. The creatures awaken. They hunt by sound. One wrong move, one misplaced breath, and your team won’t make it back to the train.

Will you uncover the secret that ended L.O.A.P… or become its next failed experiment?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64bit or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 4690 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti 4GB or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 7 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64bit or newer
  • Processor: Intel® i5-8700k / AMD Ryzen 7 1700X equivalent or greater
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVidia GeForce GTX 1070 8GB / AMD RX 580 8GB or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 7 GB available space

short_description: The Shadow: L.O.A.P is a 4-player multiplayer horror game. Four strangers, each battling a deadly illness, find themselves trapped in an abandoned metro line. Their only hope is an old train that loses power at every station.
supported_languages:
English*, French, German, Arabic, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Dutch, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Turkish, Ukrainian
*languages with full audio support
